# app-tiles

The website's app tile — how equin.ai draws an app (the gallery's cards, the
homepage's shelf): `<WebsiteAppTile symbol color />`, the glyph on a vivid
`WebsiteTileColor` (19 hues and `slate`, `core/`) as a deep-to-base diagonal
gradient on a bounded squircle. The site's look only: equin's own launchers
draw `apps-core/app-icon`'s `AppIconTile`, in its calmer palette. The catalog
(`pages/apps`) gives each app its colour.
